templates.title: Order and rate
templates.summary: The most ordered item held up, the hook, the cross-section, the menu board with prices and a score out of ten.

steps.title: Hold it up
steps.position: At the counter or the curb
steps.direction: Hold the item in one hand, phone low in the other, and move the phone in slowly until the item fills the frame.

captions.script: Their most ordered item. Is it worth the money?
The number one on the menu, fresh out of the bag.
I asked what people order most, so I got it too.

steps.title: The hook
steps.position: At the counter or the curb
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level, the item in your hand.
steps.prompter: Their most ordered item. I am rating it honestly, out of ten.

captions.script: Their most ordered item. I am rating it honestly, out of ten.
Honest score coming. Here is what I really think of it.

steps.title: Cross-section
steps.direction: Pull it apart or cut it in half, hold the phone above it at an angle and move in slowly on the inside, then flick the phone to the side.

captions.script: Look at the inside. Here is everything in there.
Cheese pull check. Let's see if it passes.
Messy, yes. Grab extra napkins at the counter.

steps.title: Menu board
steps.position: In front of the menu board
steps.direction: Stand square to the menu board, phone at chest height, and sidestep slowly along it so the prices pass.

captions.script: Here are the prices, with the combo and without.
Combo or not? Here is what the fries and drink add.
Here is the board, so you can see what fits your budget.

steps.title: The score
steps.position: At the counter or the curb, arm out
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level with the item in frame. Give your score, the price and where it is.
steps.prompter: Here is my score out of ten, the price and where it is.

captions.script: Here is my score out of ten, the price and where it is.
Here is my score, and whether I would order it again.

templates.title: Find the truck
templates.summary: Where the truck parks today: the walk-up, the order at the window, the hand-off, the bite and the hours.

steps.title: The truck
steps.direction: Start across from the truck with the whole truck in frame and walk slowly toward the window. Keep faces in the line out of frame.

captions.script: Found the truck. It is parked here today, and there is a line.
This truck has a line. Let's find out why.
Lunch on wheels, right by the office.

steps.title: Order
steps.direction: Back camera from your eyes on the menu and the window while you order. You talk on the front camera.
steps.prompter: Ordering what the person in front of me got. Smelled too good.

captions.script: Ordering what the person in front of me got. Smelled too good.
Asked what they sell the most. This is it.

steps.title: Hand-off
steps.direction: Hold the phone low at the window ledge, still, as the order is passed down to you.

captions.script: Order up. Here is how long it took, start to finish.
Hot from the window, straight into my hands.
Here is how fast the line moved to the window.

steps.title: Unwrap
steps.position: At the curb, a bench or in the car
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the order and move in slowly as you open the box or the foil.

captions.script: Look inside. Here is everything in the box.
Best seat in the house: the curb.
Eating in the car, because it would not survive the drive.

steps.title: First bite
steps.position: At the curb, a bench or in the car
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level. Lift the first bite toward the lens and react.
steps.prompter: First bite on the curb. Okay, this is why there's a line.

captions.script: First bite on the curb. Okay, this is why there's a line.
Worth the line. I would wait for this again.

steps.title: Where it parks
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level with the truck behind you. Say where it parks, the hours and the total.
steps.prompter: Here is where it parks. Check Loca for today's spot and hours.

captions.script: Here is where it parks. Check Loca for today's spot and hours.
It moves around, so check Loca before you go.

templates.title: Ten dollar run
templates.summary: How much food ten dollars buys: the hook, the menu board, two items scored, the receipt and the one to get.

steps.title: The budget
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level with the counter or the menu board behind you.
steps.prompter: Ten dollars at this counter. Let's see how much food it buys.

captions.script: Ten dollars at this counter. Let's see how much food it buys.
Budget lunch. Ten dollars, two items, and I want to be full.

steps.title: Menu board
steps.position: In front of the menu board
steps.direction: Stand below the menu board, phone at chest height tipped up at it, and sidestep slowly along it so the prices pass.

captions.script: Here are the prices. Let's see what ten dollars covers.
Picking two items, and the drink stays at home.
Here is the cheapest part of the board. That is where we start.

steps.title: Item one
steps.position: At a table or counter, phone above the item
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the first item, still, while you pick it up. You talk on the front camera, then flick the phone to the side.
steps.prompter: First item down. Crispy, salty, and here is my score.

captions.script: First item down. Crispy, salty, and here is my score.
The side is better than it needs to be for the price.

steps.title: Item two
steps.position: At a table or counter, phone low
steps.direction: Rest the phone low at the table edge and move in slowly on the second item. You talk on the front camera.
steps.prompter: Item two is the main event. Here is my score for it.

captions.script: Item two is the main event. Here is my score for it.
Here is how much of the budget this one took, and if it was worth it.

steps.title: Receipt
steps.direction: Lay the receipt flat and hold the phone straight above the total, still.

captions.script: The total with tax. Still under ten dollars.
And here is what is left over from the ten.
The receipt, so you know I am not making this up.

steps.title: The pick
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level, both wrappers in frame. Say the item to get and the venue name.
steps.prompter: Under ten bucks and full. Here is the one item to order.

captions.script: Under ten bucks and full. Here is the one item to order.
Full for under ten. Here is what to get and what to skip.

templates.title: Late night stop
templates.summary: The counter that is still open: the hook under the sign, the griddle, the order, the bite and the hours.

steps.title: Still open
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level under the lit sign.
steps.prompter: Late at night, and this counter is still open. Here's what I got.

captions.script: Late at night, and this counter is still open. Here's what I got.
Late night run, and this counter still has the lights on.

steps.title: The sign
steps.position: On the sidewalk, below the sign
steps.direction: Hold the phone low and point it up at the lit sign, then tip it down slowly to the door.

captions.script: Open late, and the sign means it.
The late night spot people tell you about after the bar.
Lights still on, grill still hot.

steps.title: On the griddle
steps.position: At the counter, with the cook's OK
steps.direction: Ask first, then hold the phone above the griddle at an angle and keep it still while the order cooks.

captions.script: Here is my order on the griddle, cooking right now.
Made fresh, even this late. Watch it cook.
Turn the sound up for this.

steps.title: The order
steps.direction: Rest the phone low on the counter and move in slowly until the order fills the frame.

captions.script: My late night order. Here is everything in it.
This is the late night order, according to the cook.
Here is what came with it, still hot.

steps.title: First bite
steps.position: At the counter or a stool
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level. Lift the first bite toward the lens and react.
steps.prompter: Late night bite at the counter. Exactly what I needed tonight.

captions.script: Late night bite at the counter. Exactly what I needed tonight.
This late, it hits harder than any dinner I had today.

steps.title: The hours
steps.direction: Step out and film the lit storefront from across the sidewalk, holding still.

captions.script: Open late. Check the hours on Loca before you go.
Remember this one for after the bar.
If there is a late night offer on Loca, use it.

templates.title: The build
templates.summary: Behind the counter: the griddle, the cook stacking the order, the wrap, the cross-section and the bite.

steps.title: On the grill
steps.position: At the counter, with the cook's OK
steps.direction: Ask first, then hold the phone above the grill or fryer at an angle and keep it still while it cooks.

captions.script: Watch them build my order, start to finish.
Fresh off the grill. Turn the sound up.
Fryer basket up, fries out, salt on.

steps.title: The build
steps.position: Behind the cook's shoulder, with their OK
steps.direction: Stand just behind the cook's shoulder and lean in slowly as they stack the order.

captions.script: Stacked to order. Here is every layer as it goes on.
Layer by layer, watch the order they go on.
Here is how long it took to build. These cooks are quick.

steps.title: Wrap it
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the counter, still, while the cook wraps or boxes the order.

captions.script: Wrapped and ready. Now the part that matters.
Foil on to keep it hot.
Into the box and over the counter.

steps.title: The inside
steps.direction: Cut it in half, hold the phone above it at an angle and move in slowly until the inside fills the screen.

captions.script: Look inside. You can see every layer they built.
The cross-section. Juicy, melted, nothing missing.
Sauce on every bite, all the way to the edge.

steps.title: First bite
steps.direction: Front camera. Start with the food right at the lens, then pull it away to your mouth and react.
steps.prompter: Watched them build it start to finish. Now the first bite.

captions.script: Watched them build it start to finish. Now the first bite.
Built right. You can taste every layer they put on.

steps.title: Order it
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level with the food in frame. Say the item name, the price and the venue.
steps.prompter: Ask for it the way the cooks make it. Here is the price.

captions.script: Ask for it the way the cooks make it. Here is the price.
Order it the cook's way. Ask them how they make theirs.

hold.reads: The item grows from below until it fills the frame; cut to the selfie.

hook.reads: A still selfie with the item in hand; cut to the back camera above it.

inside.reads: The inside grows until it fills the screen, then the frame flicks away and lands on the menu board.

menu.reads: The prices slide past at an even pace; cut to the score selfie.

score.reads: A still selfie from just above while the score and price land; hold for the end card.

truck.reads: The truck grows as we walk up until the window and the menu fill the frame; cut to our view at the window.

window.reads: Our view of the window held still while we order; cut low under the window ledge.

handoff.reads: The tray comes down out of the window toward the lens; match-cut on the same tray from straight above.

unwrap.reads: The open box grows until the filling fills the screen; cut to the bite selfie.

bite.reads: The face grows as the bite comes up; cut to a higher selfie with the truck behind.

where.reads: A still selfie with the truck behind while the spot and hours land; hold for the end card.

hook.reads: A still selfie at the counter; cut to the back camera on the menu board.

board.reads: The board looms above and its prices slide past at an even pace; cut straight overhead to the first item.

first.reads: The first item sits still under the lens while a hand takes it, then the frame flicks to the second item.

second.reads: Out of the whip the main item grows from below until it towers; cut straight down to the receipt.

receipt.reads: The total holds still in the frame; cut to the verdict selfie.

best.reads: A still selfie from just above while the pick and the total land; hold for the end card.

hook.reads: A still selfie under the sign; cut low to the sign itself.

sign.reads: The sign above gives way to the door below as the phone tips down; cut high over the griddle.

griddle.reads: The patty sizzles still in the frame; match-cut on the finished burger in the same spot from below.

order.reads: The order grows from below until it fills the frame; cut to the bite selfie.

bite.reads: The face grows as the bite comes up; cut to the lit storefront outside.

outside.reads: The lit storefront holds still in the dark street; hold for the end card.

grill.reads: The patty or the basket sizzles still in the frame; cut behind the cook's shoulder.

build.reads: From behind the cook we lean in as the layers go on; cut straight overhead to the wrap.

wrap.reads: Hands fold the wrap from above; match-cut on the same order opened and cut in half.

inside.reads: The inside grows until it fills the screen; push through it to the bite at the lens.

bite.reads: The food leaves the lens and the face appears; cut to a higher, still selfie.

outro.reads: A still selfie from just above while the name and price land; hold for the end card.
